sun.meaning: share of hourly steps over 18.6 years with any part of the Sun's disc visible

earth.meaning: share of hourly steps over 18.6 years with any part of Earth's disc visible

psr.meaning: share of the cell that is permanently shadowed

citation: Mazarico, E., Neumann, G. A., Smith, D. E., Zuber, M. T., Torrence, M. H. (2011), Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography, Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030
